mapper.select:
select * from ( select cc.contract_id, cca.contract_archive_number, cc.contract_name, case when pp.document_type in('PRJL','PRJLB') then cc.contract_number else pp.contract_number end contract_number, cc.legal_contract_number, cca.contract_archive_id, cca.status, (SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.code = 'ARCHIVE_STATUS' AND v.code_value = nvl(cca.status,'NEW') AND V.ENABLED_FLAG='Y') status_n, cca.confirm_person, (select s.DESCRIPTION from sys_user s where s.user_id=cca.confirm_person) confirm_person_n, cca.confirm_date, (select hbm.bp_name from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id = cc.tenant_id) bp_name, case when pp.document_type in('PRJL','PRJLB') then (SELECT em.name FROM fnd_employee em WHERE em.employee_id = cc.EMPLOYEE_ID) else (select s.description from sys_user s where s.user_id = cc.host_project_manager) end host_project_manager_n, pp.document_type from CON_CONTRACT_ARCHIVE cca, con_contract cc, prj_project pp where cca.contract_id = cc.contract_id and cc.project_id = pp.project_id
and ( #{createdBy}=cc.host_project_manager or #{createdBy}=cc.ASSIST_PROJECT_MANAGER OR exists( select 1 from fnd_org_unit a1,fnd_employee a2,fnd_employee_assigns a3,FND_ORG_POSITION a4 where a3.employee_id=a2.employee_id and a3.unit_id=a1.unit_id and a4.position_id=a3.position_id and a4.chief_position_flag='Y' and employee_code=#{request.employeeCode} AND A1.UNIT_ID IN( select b.unit_id from sys_user_allocation a,fnd_employee_assigns b where a.user_id=cc.host_project_manager AND a.employee_assign_id=b.employee_assign_id)) or #{request.employeeCode} in('ADMIN','HULITING') )
)t
and t.contract_archive_number like concat('%',concat(#{contractArchiveNumber},'%'))
and t.contract_name like concat('%',concat(#{contractName},'%'))
and t.contract_number like concat('%',concat(#{contractNumber},'%'))
and t.legal_contract_number like concat('%',concat(#{legalContractNumber},'%'))
order by t.contract_number desc
